Put it in the books.
记下这一胜。

quote.text:
A spectacular week in Berlin
精彩绝伦的柏林一周，

ends with tears of joy for Linda Noskova.
以诺斯科娃喜极而泣收尾。

It's been a bit of a wait
这场等待，有些漫长，

for her second career title,
她的生涯第二冠终于到来，

but she gets it on the grass in Germany
她在德国的草地上夺冠，

at the expense of the former champion Jessica Pegula.
击败的是前冠军佩古拉。

Another classic between these two.
两人又奉献了一场经典。

But in the end, it's the serve and first-strike tennis
最终，是发球和第一拍进攻，

of Linda Noskova that gets her home.
让诺斯科娃笑到最后。

What a relief she will feel,
她一定会感到如释重负，

after those almost-but-not-quite moments of last year,
去年，她曾多次功亏一篑，

when she made three finals but couldn't get it done.
三次进决赛，却都没能夺冠。

She has here.
这一次，她做到了。
